title: Clawd X Digest
summary: ChatGPT Co-Inventor Unveils 'Jev' Decision Model: Diogo Almeida released Jev, a novel frontier model trained via RLCD optimized exclusively for decision-making (no text output), operating 20–200x faster and 40–400x cheaper with free output tokens.

Claude Opus 5.2 Hands-On Benchmarks Detail Agentic Leap: Developers report Anthropic's Opus 5.2 sets a new standard in subagent delegation, intent recognition, and token-efficient tool/MCP execution without early environment probing.

Nous Research Cleans 1M Lines of Code via 1,393 Subagents: Nous Research deployed Hermes Agent across 1,393 parallel subagents over 19 hours to trim 34.4% of its codebase, saving an estimated $2 million in developer hours.

Andrej Karpathy Delivers First Anthropic Lecture on Agent Loops: Following his move to Anthropic, Karpathy presented a framework covering autonomous agent loops, evaluation harnesses, and self-improving code systems.

Crypto Clarity Act Faces Senate Showdown as Fed Decision Looms: Senator Cynthia Lummis warned the draft Crypto Clarity Act faces a pivotal congressional vote, while the White House affirmed it will respect Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's rate announcement.

items.title: @CompleteSkeptic & @AnatoliKopadze: ChatGPT Co-Inventor Launches 'Jev' Decision Engine
items.body: Diogo Almeida revealed Jev, a specialized decision model trained using RLCD that skips text generation entirely to deliver 20-200x speedups and 40-400x cost reductions with zero output token fees.

items.title: @Gegam245074: Claude Opus 5.2 Benchmark Shows Advanced Subagent Delegation
items.body: First-hand testing of Opus 5.2 highlights its ability to manage skills and MCP tools intelligently without token waste, along with subagents that actively critique and correct parent agent tasks.

items.title: @NousResearch: 1,393 Subagents Refactor 1 Million Lines of Code in 19 Hours
items.body: Nous Research reported using Hermes Agent to orchestrate 1,393 concurrent subagents, successfully shrinking their Python repository by 34.4% and saving nearly $2M in engineering costs.

items.title: @tspy & @karpathy: Karpathy Presents First Anthropic Lecture on Self-Improving Agents
items.body: Andrej Karpathy delivered his inaugural lecture at Anthropic, outlining core architecture principles for autonomous agent loops, testing harnesses, and recursive self-improvement.

items.title: @EMostaque: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Economics Challenge Frontier Model Moats
items.body: Emad Mostaque noted DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash cost $10M to train and operates at 1/100th the inference cost of GPT-6 Astra while matching performance on design benchmarks.

items.title: @trq212: MCP Architecture Surpasses Traditional CLI Agent Integrations
items.body: Developers highlight Model Context Protocol (MCP) as superior to CLI integrations for LLM tools due to improved tool-calling reliability, statelessness, and dynamic query filtering.

items.title: @MTSlive: Periodic Labs Trains H200 Model Outperforming Astra on Internal Suite
items.body: Periodic Labs utilized 1,300 H200 GPUs and months of experimental lab data to train an open-weight model outperforming GPT-6 Astra on proprietary benchmarks.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Senator Lummis Issues Warning on Crypto Clarity Act Vote
items.body: Senator Cynthia Lummis warned that the pending Crypto Clarity Act faces an urgent make-or-break vote in Congress to establish federal regulatory frameworks for digital assets.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: White House Affirms Support for Upcoming Fed Rate Decision
items.body: The White House confirmed President Trump will respect Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming interest rate announcement following FOMC deliberations.

items.title: @The_Money_Buddy: Financial Benchmarks & Early-Career Wealth Perception
items.body: Personal finance discussions focused on career benchmarks, highlighting how social media skewing skews young professionals' perception of retirement and savings targets.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano & @Bayern_PR: Rodri & Müller Discuss Ballon d'Or Race
items.body: Rodri and Thomas Müller shared perspectives on the Ballon d'Or race, with Müller endorsing Harry Kane's goal-scoring consistency over media campaigning.

items.title: @FIFAWorldCup & @espn: Football Community Prepares for World Cup Countdown
items.body: FIFA World Cup updates and viral college football highlights—including a 100-yard kick return TD by Georgia Tech—dominated sports discussion.

items.title: @elonmusk: Elon Musk Cites 'The Machine Stops' Over Blizzard Server Issues
items.body: Elon Musk referenced E.M. Forster's classic sci-fi essay 'The Machine Stops' in response to launch day login server outages on Blizzard's latest title.
